turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Guests are coming Saturday and the whole place is a mess. I've got maybe two hours tomorrow.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Two hours is enough if you focus. Should we start with the kitchen and bathroom, or the living room where everyone will sit?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold that thought, I need to talk to Jordan real quick. Stay quiet until I return.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Which beans did you buy this time?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Some Ethiopian ones. The guy at the market said they're fruity.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just try it. It tastes a bit like berries, honestly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine. Should I grind them fine or coarse for the pour-over?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Medium, like sand. Not too fine or it gets bitter.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Medium, okay. I'll make us both one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done talking to them. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. So, kitchen and bathroom first, or the living room?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Living room. That's what people will actually see.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair enough. Clear the surfaces, vacuum, and fluff the cushions, and it'll look great fast.
